meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 对指定目录做 Karpathy 模式 wiki 识别：检测结构后运行脚本扫描文章与链接，再派分析器抽取隐含关联，最终生成知识图谱 JSON 并自动触发可视化仪表板。
howto.when: 当用户给出一个 wiki 目录路径，或要求分析 Karpathy 模式知识库时触发；若没给目录则作用于当前目录。

say.text: 分析这个目录，它符合 Karpathy 模式吗？
say.note: 会先检测目录结构再决定是否继续。
将对该文件夹扫描并生成知识图谱。

say.text: 帮我给这份知识库做一篇图谱总结。
say.note: 将用子代理抽取隐含关联，最后显示仪表板。

howto.what_en: Detects whether a target folder is a Karpathy-pattern wiki; if so, scans articles and links via scripts, dispatches analyzers for implicit relations, then generates a knowledge-graph JSON and auto-launches a dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze a Karpathy-pattern wiki or provides a directory; if no path is given, it uses the current directory.

say_en.text: Analyze this folder — is it a Karpathy-pattern wiki?
say_en.note: It checks the structure first, then proceeds if valid.
It scans that folder and produces a knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Summarize this knowledge base as a graph.
say_en.note: It extracts implicit relations and opens the dashboard.
